bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; authorizing Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee, to qualify under the long-term facilities maintenance revenue program as a district eligible for alternative facilities revenue; amending Laws 1999, chapter 241, article 4, section 25, subdivision 3, as added.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 1999, chapter 241, article 4, section 25, subdivision 3, as added by Laws 2011, First Special Session chapter 11, article 4, section 7, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Independent School District No. 284, Wayzata[+; Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee+].
[+(a) +]Independent School District No. 284, Wayzata, is eligible for the alternative facilities revenue program under Minnesota Statutes[+ 2011+], section 123B.59, for the purposes of financing school facilities in the district.

[+(b) Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, beginning in fiscal year 2027, Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee, is a qualifying alternative facilities district for purposes of long-term facilities maintenance revenue under Minnesota Statutes, section 123B.595. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for fiscal year 2027 and later. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; authorizing Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee, to qualify under the long-term facilities maintenance revenue program as a district eligible for alternative facilities revenue; amending Laws 1999, chapter 241, article 4, section 25, subdivision 3, as added.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 1999, chapter 241, article 4, section 25, subdivision 3, as added by Laws 2011, First Special Session chapter 11, article 4, section 7, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Independent School District No. 284, Wayzata; Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee.
(a) Independent School District No. 284, Wayzata, is eligible for the alternative facilities revenue program under Minnesota Statutes 2011, section 123B.59, for the purposes of financing school facilities in the district.

(b) Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, beginning in fiscal year 2027, Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee, is a qualifying alternative facilities district for purposes of long-term facilities maintenance revenue under Minnesota Statutes, section 123B.595.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for fiscal year 2027 and later.
additions: (b) Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, beginning in fiscal year 2027, Independent School District No. 720, Shakopee, is a qualifying alternative facilities district for purposes of long-term facilities maintenance revenue under Minnesota Statutes, section 123B.595.
This section is effective for fiscal year 2027 and later.
